Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Associate Director, Software Engineering.
Business:
CIB Technology
Job ID
：
62957
Principal Responsibilities
Set the strategy and technical direction for the AI gateway and broader knowledge in Agentic AI, defining agent architecture, standards, and guardrails that scale consistently bank-wide.
Lead optimization of the AI Agent to improve performance, scalability, resilience and cost efficiency, enabling Generative and Agentic AI use cases across GPS.
Lead the evaluation and adoption of AI and ML technologies for CEAIA, with a focus on LLM, agentic AI, RAG, knowledge management, and emerging engineering patterns.
Embed AI-native capabilities into engineering workflows, such as AI coding, technical solution generation, test case generation, test report generation, and automated environment setup/orchestration.
Lead architecture design and core capability development for AI Agent Applications, including task orchestration, tool invocation, context management, memory mechanisms, and multi-agent collaboration.
Own end-to-end delivery from design through rollout and continuous improvement, ensuring low-latency performance and reliability for agent-driven applications.
Runtime governance & operational framework, Establish AI agent runtime and governance frameworks, including Isolation and sandboxing, Access control and permission, Auditability and traceability Evaluation and quality measurement.
Knowledge augmentation layer design: integrate, and apply enterprise knowledge enhancement capabilities, including RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), GraphRAG, Knowledge graphs (design, integration, and application)
Partner across business lines and infrastructure team to align priorities, integrate requirements and unblock delivery across regions and time zones
Provide strong technical leadership through hands-on architecture/design reviews, incident learnings and mentoring to raise engineering standards.
Build and lead a high-performing global team, ensuring capabilities and delivered fit-for-purpose with consistent quality.
Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
8+ of experience delivering enterprise software/platform solutions including 3+ years in senior engineering leadership roles, especially 2+ years in Agentic AI development.
System thinking: Strong ability to design and evolve complex systems with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and performance.
Proficient in Python with strong coding fundamentals and architectural judgment; hands-on experience delivering complex systems. The candidate must have strong coding skills in Numpy, Panas, NLU, NLP and machine learning algorithms.
Deep understanding of LLMs and agent architectures, including:
Task decomposition & planning
Tool use / function calling patterns
Context and session management
Memory design
Execution loops and exception handling
Practical experience with LangChain and/or LangGraph (or equivalent orchestration frameworks).
Familiarity with mainstream AI coding and developer tools (examples: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot or equvlenece).
Hands-on experience designing and implementing enterprise RAG, GraphRAG, or knowledge graph solutions for real application scenarios.
Proven track record designing, building, and operating large-scale, low-latency, highly available, resilient platforms and shared services (API gateway/service gateway experience strongly preferred)
Experience building secure-by-design platforms in regulated environments, with strong understanding of non-functional requirements (security, resilience, data protection, auditability)
Strong knowledge of AI capabilities and their applications in financial services, including working knowledge of Generative AI/LLM platform patterns (model access, prompt/tooling services, guardrails, evaluation/monitoring) and how to enabler safe consumption at scale.
Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing global teams spanning AI SMEs and full stack engineers across multiple regions and time zones.
Strong stakeholder management skills, able to align business lines, infrastructure and control functions; clearly articulate AI capabilities and influence senior technology and business leaders.
Experience working in Agile delivery models with strong collaboration and execution discipline.
/51/LP/WX
About HSBC Technology China
We develop, implement and support software and IT services and processes that allow HSBC to remain at the forefront of high-quality banking systems.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Director Group AI Platform Engineering
jobs.descriptionText:
The Opportunity
The CTO team is seeking a visionary, hands-on engineering leader to design, build, and scale HSBC Agent Platform as a core capability within the Group AI Platform. This role will deliver secure, reusable and high-performance platform services that enables team across the bank to build, deploy and operate agentic and generative AI solutions consistently, overing orchestration, tool integration, memory, evaluation and governance-by-design. You’ll set the technical direction, drive reliability and adoption at scale and ensure the platform meets enterprise standard for performance, resilience, security and controls.
What You’ll Do
Define the long-term technical vision and roadmap for the Agent platform in collaboration with product management team
Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of a robust, scalable, and high-performance Agent platform
Stay at the cutting edge of AI and agent movement in the industry, and adapt the agent platform to leverage the technical evolving in the industry
Work closely with technology teams across business lines to understand their requirements and ensure the platform empowers them to build agents efficiently
Integrate agent platform as part of the Group AI Platform which spans on-premise and cloud-based infrastructure
Build and manage a high-performing global team of ML SMEs and full stack engineers, to ensure the AI capabilities are built fit for purpose with high quality
Establish engineering best practices, including continuous integration / continuous delivery pipeline workflows, automation testing framework, and monitoring systems for AI applications, and ensure continuous improvement of engineering practices
Implement observability, reliability, and performance optimizations for agent platform in production
Ensure compliance to architecture principle, technical standards, security requirements and software development life cycle controls
Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related subject area
15+ of experience in developing and implementing software solutions, with 5+ years in technical leadership roles.
Hands-on experience in design and development of agentic AI solutions
Proven and deep experience in designing, building, and delivering a large-scale Agent platform
Deep understanding of the agent paradigm, including agent planning, short-term and long-term memory, tool use, agent orchestration and agent evaluation
Experience with high code and low code agent platform
Strong experience in designing and building scalable and resilient platform
Proven ability in building and managing high performing teams of AI SME and full stack engineers
Solid hands-on development skills in programming language such as Java, Python, and CI/CD tools, automation testing, and observability
Proficiency in effective stakeholder management, and capable of effectively articulating AI capabilities, and influencing both business and technology leaders
Experience working in Agile development teams with excellent collaboration skills

jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC
Corporate and Institutional Banking(CIB)
- Markets
Global Markets is part of our HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking division, a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Our Markets business is one of the largest of its kind in the world. It combines sophisticated 24-hour global coverage with a detailed knowledge of local markets. Our services are offered both online and offline in 58 countries and territories. We specialise in foreign exchange, credits and rates, structured derivatives, equities and debt, equity and equity-linked capital markets.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Contribute to Global Markets sales revenue generation, return targets set by business performance and objectives
Identify sales opportunities that address specific needs for our clients and managing from identification to point of sale and through post trade process
Service a portfolio of Strategic and/or Focus clients, including Transactional clients where required
Manage and develop relationships with transactional clients, including those serviced over e-platforms for flow based business.
Provide day to day sales coverage using the full suite of Corporate Sales offerings and support team members to do the same
Deliver services and solutions that meet client needs and where necessary leverage the bank’s depth of product expertise and Thought Leadership
Develop trusted relationships with clients to drive revenue growth and greater product penetration
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Bachelor's or equivalent University degree, minimum 10 years' relevant experience as a Global Markets corporate sales
Well versed with Global Markets and relevant Global Markets products, local regulations, regulatory requirements, market practices and business trends
Experienced in handling and dealing with local commercial banking or corporate clients in East China will be preferred
Excellent verbal and written communication skills both in Chinese and English with very strong people interaction ability
Strong interpersonal skills, open minded, be able to present best-fit solutions for client needs
Ability to explore business network, acquire and on-board new client names
Strong sense of operational risk management and ability to adhere to the Bank's operational risk requirements
Attention to detail and ability to ensure that transactions, business information is captured in a timely and highly accurate manner
Able to work independently with limited supervision, proactive and willing to run job duties under pressure against multiple deadlines
Business Travels will be required
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering.
Business:
CIB Technology
Job ID
：
62635
Principal Responsibilities
Technology leadership for the Client Distribution pillar
Lead the end-to-end technology agenda for the Client Distribution pillar within DSG.
Translate business and product strategy into a clear technology roadmap and execution plan.
Partner with the Business Lead and Product Owner Lead to define priorities, sequencing, and delivery outcomes.
Ensure technology decisions support the pillar strategy, client experience goals, and long-term platform scalability.
Position AI Markets effectively as the digital distribution front door for DSG, ensuring the underlying technology supports a seamless, scalable, and differentiated client experience.
Represent the pillar in DSG-wide technology planning, governance, and prioritisation forums.
AI-enabled platform and digital capability leadership
Provide technology leadership for AI-enabled client distribution capabilities, including intelligent workflows, digital content delivery, data-driven services, and agentic or assisted user experiences where relevant.
Ensure AI capabilities are implemented in a way that is scalable, supportable, explainable where needed, and aligned with business value.
Partner with product, engineering, and control stakeholders to embed AI responsibly into client-facing workflows and services.
Bring sufficient understanding of AI/LLM-enabled platforms, orchestration patterns, and operational considerations to guide design decisions and delivery trade-offs.
Ensure AI-enabled solutions are integrated into the broader digital platform architecture rather than developed as isolated point solutions.
Delivery and execution
Own technology delivery across the Client Distribution portfolio, ensuring execution against committed outcomes, timelines, and quality standards.
Drive coordinated delivery across engineering teams, platform teams, architecture, control functions, and dependent pillars.
Ensure delivery is pragmatic, transparent, and aligned to business value.
Manage delivery risks, dependencies, and trade-offs across a complex stakeholder landscape.
Promote disciplined execution, clear accountability, and strong delivery governance.
Platform, architecture, and engineering direction
Shape the target technology architecture for Client Distribution in alignment with DSG and enterprise direction.
Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, secure, and reusable where appropriate.
Drive engineering quality, technical consistency, and sound lifecycle management across the pillar.
Partner with horizontal pillars and shared platform teams to leverage common capabilities and avoid fragmented solutions.
Support modernisation of client-facing platforms, APIs, workflow services, and digital channel capabilities.
Ensure AI and digital distribution capabilities are built on strong platform foundations with appropriate observability, supportability, and lifecycle controls.
Production stability and operational readiness
Be accountable for the operational health and production readiness of technology services within the pillar.
Ensure appropriate support models, monitoring, controls, resilience, and incident management disciplines are in place.
Drive continuous improvement in platform stability, service quality, and operational maturity.
Ensure new capabilities are production-ready and supported by appropriate runbooks, controls, and service ownership.
Oversee remediation of production issues and structural improvements to reduce recurring incidents.
Governance, risk, and control
Ensure the pillar operates within appropriate technology governance, risk, and control frameworks.
Bring a strong control mindset to all aspects of delivery and platform management, particularly for client-facing and AI-enabled capabilities.
Ensure solutions are designed and operated with appropriate controls around data usage, access, model governance, resilience, auditability, and change management.
Partner closely with control, risk, cybersecurity, architecture, and governance teams to ensure solutions are well-managed and sustainable at scale.
Support effective management of audit, security, resilience, and regulatory expectations relevant to the platform estate.
Drive disciplined change management, release governance, and lifecycle controls across the pillar.
Stakeholder management and organisational leadership
Build strong partnerships across business, product, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity, architecture, and control teams.
Provide clear leadership communication on strategy, delivery progress, risks, and decisions.
Align stakeholders across competing priorities while maintaining focus on pillar outcomes.
Contribute to DSG leadership discussions on technology direction, operating model, and execution priorities.
Act as a senior technology leader for the pillar, fostering collaboration, accountability, and high standards.
People and team leadership
Lead and develop technology teams aligned to the Client Distribution pillar.
Set clear expectations on engineering quality, ownership, delivery discipline, and collaboration.
Build a strong leadership culture focused on execution, resilience, continuous improvement, and control awareness.
Support organisation design, capability build-out, and talent development as the pillar evolves.
Scope of the pillar
The Client Distribution pillar supports digital client channels and services across institutional and corporate client workflows, including:
Sophisticated pre-trade workflows
Pricing and execution
Post-trade and chat-enabled workflows
Channels including web, mobile, chat, and API-based distribution
Content and services including platform-based data feeds, risk services, AI Markets Premium, and data / AI-enabled / agentic workflows and services
AI Markets is a core part of this pillar as the distribution front door for DSG, providing a unified digital entry point for client and user interaction with DSG capabilities.
Experience
Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications
Significant experience in senior technology leadership roles within digital platforms, electronic channels, or client-facing enterprise technology.
Proven track record leading complex technology delivery across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Experience owning large-scale platforms or product-aligned technology domains with both build and run accountability.
Strong experience in managing technology strategy, architecture direction, and execution in a controlled enterprise environment.
Experience working closely with business and product leadership in a high-demand delivery setting.
Experience with AI-enabled products, intelligent workflow platforms, or data-driven digital capabilities in an enterprise setting is strongly preferred.
Skills And Capabilities
Strong strategic thinking combined with practical delivery focus.
Ability to lead across architecture, engineering, delivery, production support, and control dimensions.
Good understanding of AI/LLM-enabled solutions and the practical considerations for deploying them in production environments.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability across senior business and technology audiences.
Strong judgment in balancing pace, innovation, control, resilience, and long-term sustainability.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technology topics for varied audiences.

.

Senior technical IC leadership for knowledge intelligence: Act as a hands-on senior technical expert in knowledge intelligence and knowledge management, shaping architecture, technical direction, and implementation approach for an enterprise-grade knowledge platform.
Knowledge platform architecture & delivery ownership: Lead the design and build of scalable platform capabilities across ingestion, extraction, enrichment, classification, knowledge asset management, discovery, reuse, governance, and controlled downstream consumption.
Industry best practice adoption & engineering standards: Evaluate knowledge management, knowledge engineering, ontology/taxonomy, graph, and AI-assisted curation practices, and translate them into engineering standards, reusable patterns, reference architectures, APIs/SDKs, and runbooks.

Optimisation & operational readiness: Define SLOs/SLAs, observability, alerting, capacity planning, cost controls, incident response, troubleshooting playbooks, resilience patterns, and continuous production improvement for knowledge platform services.
Cross-team influence & enablement: Partner with AI engineering, data platforms, cybersecurity, architecture, product, and domain SMEs to drive adoption, mentor engineers, review designs, unblock complex issues, and communicate trade-offs to senior stakeholders.
Requirements
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Management, Data Engineering, AI, or a related technical discipline; 7+ years of hands-on engineering experience in backend, data, AI, knowledge, search, or enterprise information platforms.
Proven experience as a senior technical IC or platform technical lead, owning architecture, engineering standards, design review, implementation quality, optimisation, and production readiness for complex platform capabilities.
Deep knowledge of knowledge intelligence and management practices, including taxonomy/ontology design, metadata standards, knowledge refinement, lifecycle management, governance, lineage, and enterprise content operations.
Hands-on experience with knowledge graph, semantic search, RAG, agentic AI, or data enrichment systems, plus strong engineering foundations in distributed systems, APIs, data pipelines, observability, CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Strong security, compliance, production, and stakeholder mindset, with the ability to adopt industry best practices, mentor engineers, influence cross-functional teams, and apply AI-native approaches to improve quality, productivity, and decision-making.

jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio
Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance
Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline
At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.
Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
Fluency in Mandarin and English
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. Messaging and streaming platforms—Kafka (or equivalent).

Understanding of tokenisation, context limits, temperature tuning, and model-specific behaviours across major LLM providers.
Experience structuring prompts for tool/function calling, structured JSON output, and multi-turn conversations.
DevOps & Infrastructure
Kubernetes—deployments, services, ingress, Helm, Kustomize, HPA, and RBAC.
CI/CD pipelines—GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent.

Cloud platforms—AWS, AliCloud,GCP, or Azure.

jobs.descriptionText:

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Global Head of SSv Product Solutions Technology
Business: SecSvcs & Digital Assets Tech
Job ID
：55992
Securities Services (SSv) is a profitable, scalable, capital-light business at the heart of the Group’s transaction banking, institutional client and wealth ambitions. SSv Technology is a 1,000+ strong global engineering organisation partnering with SSv and colleagues across HSBC to deliver resilient, secure, and industry-leading technology services.
We’re seeking an accomplished technology executive to join as Global Head of SSv Product Solutions Technology, accountable for setting strategy, leading global delivery, and driving measurable outcomes across our product solutions portfolio.
This role is suited to a hands-on, engineering focused technologist with a strong product mindset and a passion for building high-quality products and services for clients, customers and colleagues. You will bring a pragmatic, outcomes-led approach to engineering, architecture and design, and will be comfortable solving complex challenges at scale within a large, global organisation. You will also champion open, collaborative engineering practices.
Reporting to the Global Securities Services Technology CIO, you’ll set direction and lead global delivery for Product Solutions Technology. You’ll build and inspire a high-performing, multi-disciplinary organisation of delivery managers, solution architects, data analysts and full-stack engineers across Hong Kong, Guangzhou, Bangalore, Pune and London. Working closely with business, operations, cyber security, risk and architecture partners, you’ll drive measurable outcomes—modernising platforms, improving reliability and controls, and accelerating time-to-market—while developing talent and strengthening our engineering culture.
What You’ll Do (principal Accountabilities)
Drive measurable outcomes through technology
Deliver business value as quickly and as safely as possible, balancing pace with resilience and long-term sustainability.
Own and actively manage a well-defined roadmap, including internal and external dependencies, ensuring transparent prioritisation and delivery governance.
Coordinate planning across multiple value streams and teams, optimising plans to maximise benefits and minimise risk.
Define performance measures that track delivery outcomes, client adoption/engagement and service health, and act decisively where outcomes aren’t being met.
Build great digital products, journeys and new capabilities
Scale reusable technology foundations across digital, data and innovation to increase adoption, accelerate delivery and strengthen cross-team collaboration.
Define a target-state architecture that incorporates existing and future technologies to balance pace and disruption, aligned to HSBC architectural principles.
Lead the design, delivery and implementation of technology change impacting platforms—from bug-fix through to major enhancements and re-engineering.
Establish a strong client and stakeholder feedback loop, ensuring deliverables are accepted and lessons learned are captured through formal retrospectives.
Scale AI, automation and modern engineering practices
Innovate using emerging technologies including AI/ML, cloud, big data, APIs and DLT, translating opportunities into tangible business value.
Scale an AI and automation approach that improves client experience, operational efficiency and developer productivity, with appropriate governance and controls.
Champion engineering excellence and continuous improvement, uplifting capability across the organisation through modern practices (e.g., Agile, DevSecOps) and a strong learning culture.
Promote high-cadence delivery into production and remove barriers when throughput slows—working with team leads, IT leadership and business partners to improve flow.
Strengthen resilience, risk management and service quality
Put stability at the heart of delivery: ensure services are designed to operate, observable, supportable and resilient.
Drive consistent uplift in monitoring, alerting and operational automation to reduce avoidable incidents and improve recovery.
Anticipate and manage risks, issues and interdependencies; provide timely, clear reporting and constructive challenge to ensure problems are surfaced early and addressed.
Lead value creation and financial stewardship
Act as a visible change leader with business sponsors—owning outcomes, benefits and adoption.
Develop and manage business cases (investment, benefits and financial linkage) and ensure benefits realisation through to implementation and transition.
Manage budgets with strong control and transparency; act on variance and manage to the value proposition.
Identify and remove barriers to success, addressing difficult topics directly and constructively in HSBC’s best interests.
Build a high-performing, inclusive global team
Identify and manage resource requirements to build effective international, multi-disciplinary teams; source talent balancing cost, quality and internal capability.
Set clear objectives and responsibilities; ensure strong induction, orientation and ongoing coaching.

You will bring a pragmatic, outcomes-led approach to engineering, architecture and design, and will be comfortable solving complex challenges at scale within a large, global organisation. Reporting to the Global Securities Services Technology CIO, you’ll set direction and lead global delivery for Product Solutions Technology. You’ll build and inspire a high-performing, multi-disciplinary organisation of delivery managers, solution architects, data analysts and full-stack engineers across Hong Kong, Guangzhou, Bangalore, Pune and London. Drive the integration of AI/ML capabilities into production systems with appropriate controls for governance, model risk, explainability and data privacy.
Collaborate with product, security, ops and data teams to prioritise technical debt, reliability improvements and platform investments.
Represent engineering in stakeholder forums, technical governance boards and external partner engagements.
What you will be doing
Act as the technical owner for core platform domains, driving architecture, design and delivery across backend, data streaming and cloud infrastructure; focus deeply on 2–3 areas (e.g., Java/Spring, Kafka/Stream Processing, Cloud/Kubernetes).
Lead targeted technical deep‑dives (2–3 per quarter) to resolve architectural trade‑offs, eliminate chronic pain points and transfer knowledge across teams.
Own and deliver the Tech Risk Control book‑of‑work items for your area: define remediations, coordinate cross‑functional delivery, produce evidence for audits and close out controls.
Run structured root‑cause analysis and blameless post‑mortems for major incidents, translate findings into prioritized fixes, and ensure follow‑through.
Provide hands‑on technical direction: participate in design reviews, code reviews, prototyping and proof‑of‑concepts to validate architecture decisions.
Mentor senior engineers and engineering leads; raise team capability through coaching, workshops and documented standards/patterns.
Collaborate with product, security, data and ops to align technical strategy with business objectives, regulatory requirements and non‑functional goals (scalability, resilience, security).
Drive adoption of cloud‑native and DevOps practices (CI/CD, observability) and ensure production readiness for new services and AI/ML components.
Qualifications
Certifications & Education
University degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline; MSc/PhD preferred.
Cloud certification(s) strongly preferred: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.
Desirable: Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD), security or data governance certificates.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in financial services or regulated industries with demonstrable knowledge of regulatory controls, audit preparation and model risk governance.
Contributions to open source projects or academic/industry research; speaker at technical conferences is a plus.
Proven ability to lead cross‑functional engineering teams through technological transformations, and to operationalise AI safely at scale.
Deliverables & Success Measures
Architecture and platform designs that meet non‑functional requirements (scalability, resiliency, security).
Successful delivery of prioritized Tech Risk Control book‑of‑work items and remediation actions.
Reduction in incident mean‑time‑to‑detect and mean‑time‑to‑recover through improved observability, RCA and runbooks.
Mature AI/ML deployment pipelines with documented governance, monitoring and model lifecycle controls.
High team engagement, evidence of knowledge transfer via deep dive sessions and measurable uplift in engineering capability.
Technical Skills & Experience
Familiar on one or more tech skill.
Strong Java expertise (Java 8/11/17/21/25), demonstrated through large‑scale, production systems.
Deep experience with Spring ecosystem: Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data and related tooling.
Microservices and cloud‑native architectures: containerisation (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) and 12‑factor app principles.
Event streaming and messaging: Apache Kafka (Kafka Streams, ksqlDB), Confluent tooling and best practices for exactly‑once semantics and fault‑tolerant processing.
Data platform familiarity: batch/stream processing (Spark, Flink), data lakehouse concepts (Delta Lake), and data governance tools (e.g. Apache Atlas, Apache Falcon or equivalent).
AI / ML / LLM productionisation: hands‑on with MLOps and Model frameworks (LangGraph, Agent Development Kit, Microsoft Agent Framework ); experience deploying and operating LLMs (e.g., Falcon family or other LLMs), embeddings, RAG architectures and frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
Observability, reliability and performance engineering: Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/EFK, distributed tracing (Jaeger/Zipkin), profiling and tuning high‑throughput systems.
DevOps, CI/CD :Terraform, Ansible , G3 , and SonarQube.
Cloud platforms: proven experience on at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) in production scale environments.
Security, compliance & risk controls: secure coding practices, threat modelling, encryption, key management and OWASP mitigation patterns.

jobs.descriptionText:

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Tech Lead - Core Systems Infrastructure Modernization & AI Engineering
Business: CTO Infrastructure, Asia & Middle East
Job ID：56478
Principal Responsibilities
We are seeking a visionary, hands-on
Tech Lead
to spearhead the next-generation modernisation of our high-scale Hong Kong platforms and regional architecture. As part of HSBC’s core technology and digital transformation blueprint for the next four years, this role will drive the transition from legacy stacks to resilient in-house managed, build using open-source architectures, hybrid-cloud deployments, and secure, production-grade AI engineering capabilities.
You will own the infrastructure technical roadmap, engineering execution, and architectural integrity for mission-critical client and operational platforms, ensuring low-latency performance, strict regulatory alignment, and continuous delivery at scale.
Database & Platform Modernization:
Lead the modernization, advocacy and replatforming of database technologies from traditional relational DBMS (eg: DB2) to distributed databases (eg: Oceanbase) for our high-scale Hong Kong core services.
Lead the end-to-end Infrastructure refactoring and migration of core legacy services to modern, open-source-aligned, modern architectures.
Implement scalable containerization strategies (utilising advanced cluster networking and storage setups, e.g., Multus CNI integration) to handle heavy enterprise workloads.
Optimise high-throughput backend infrastructure, ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, and minimal technical debt across microservices.
AI & Data Engineering Integration:
Architect and scale the foundational infrastructure required to support high-density AI and data engineering workloads, including enterprise-grade GPU clusters, high-performance distributed storage, and low-latency networking fabrics.
Establish enterprise-wide AI-Ops and MLOps platforms that automate model deployment, scaling, monitoring, and lifecycle governance across hybrid-cloud environments.
Optimize large-scale data ingestion and storage pipelines to support petabyte-scale real-time data streaming and distributed database architectures without compromising core banking availability.

CIB - Global Trade Solutions (GTS)
Trade has been the foundation of HSBC since 1865, it is evolving fast and so are we. With our network, expertise, and solutions we’re placed to help clients make sense of emerging trends, risks, and opportunities by being the global connectors, innovative problem solvers and strategic partners.
We connect the world through trade. Our footprint gives clients access to roughly 90% of world trade flows providing a powerful mix of local, regional, and global knowledge to help them spot new growth opportunities. We are innovative problem solvers that provide a safer, smoother digital trade experience. We solve business challenges through growth, disruption, or uncertainty, and we bring clients insights and ideas to enable grow and protect their business.
Our comprehensive suite of products and services can be combined into global solutions that help make it easier for businesses to manage trade risk, process trade transactions, and fund trade activities.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Be responsible for generating sales and match the solution within the GTS offering that meets client specific needs.
Develop new revenue streams by proactively identifying new customers and promoting innovative GTS solutions.
Understand the risk profile of e-commerce industry and relevant products and act as the sales representative on opportunities with key clients/ deals.
Assist in establishing new business relationships and strengthening existing ones, whilst ensuring fair outcomes for all types of clients
Assist in the communication of new products, propositions and relevant market information to clients. Participate in events, initiatives and activities to develop business opportunities
Protect the bank's reputation and ensure an acceptable risk profile whilst deepening your understanding of the client through credit and customer due diligence reviews
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Communication skills
Trade finance product & working capital knowledge, Experience in e-commerce financing would be considered a strong advantage.
Experience of promoting new products in a matrix environment
Teamwork and multi-task capacity

jobs.title: Corporate Banking Manager
jobs.descriptionText:
Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB)
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
To maximize the revenues of customer portfolio and increase the Bank's share of customer wallets
To maintain a high level of credit quality in the jobholder's customer portfolio and to mitigate the hidden risks of the evolving Banking products
To build effective customer relationships and to become the customers' preferred financial partner and trusted advisor.
To coordinate the Customer Service Team (CST) to ensure the clients' needs are covered in a proactive and efficient manner.
To be conversant with the global/local economies and able to respond to business opportunity faster than the Bank's competitors.
To be capable of discussing confidently and professionally with clients, a wide range of bank products which cover capital market, derivative products, M&A, global cash management, structured trade finance, insurance and asset management, etc.
To keep abreast of the trend and development of the sector/industries.
To preserve HSBC's reputation by strictly complying with the increasingly stringent external regulatory requirements.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Ability to provide marketing support to senior relationship managers
Ability to establish rapport with members of client's management team
Ability to provide good analytical support to senior relationship managers
Strong PC skills (excel, PowerPoint etc.)
Good team player
Knowledge of HSBC Group structures and products
Good verbal and written communication skills
Knowledge of the spectrum of banking products and services
Understanding of risk management and credit mitigants
Good level of financial analysis ability

jobs.descriptionText:
Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB)
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Responsible for the delivery of Business Credit Office (BCO) tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs
Own the end-to-end Credit & Lending servicing journey, ensuring a seamless and efficient process for customers and internal stakeholders
Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk
Continuously drive improvement in their productivity whilst enhancing client experience.
Adopt technology and customer experience improvement initiatives, including alignment to a globally consistent C&L operating model and active participation in training initiatives
Participate in deal discussions and meetings with clients or credit risk as required
Strong execution and implementation ability.
Ability to build and maintain strong relationships across the teams, including credibility with both Business and Risk leaders.
Protect the Bank by acting as First Line of Defence and adhering to all controls
Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit recomentations, along with addressing any issues raised by external regulators
Demonstrates ability to engage in constructive and consistent dialogue with risk partners, in a manner that effectively balances commercial outcomes and risk management
Work with the BCO Team Lead to ensure adequate credit risk management controls are built into the operational process and robust MI is in place to track and measure risk against agreed thresholds

jobs.descriptionText:
About The Role
We’re seeking someone to join our Finance team as a Finance Controller in Global Corporate Controllers to ensure the integrity of relevant legal entity’s general ledger, financial disclosures and regulatory submission.
In the Finance division, we act as a partner to business units around the globe by providing management, review, analysis and advisory services of the Firm’s financial and capital resources. This is an Associate level position within our Corporate Controllers, Reporting & Accounting Job Family which is responsible for the accuracy and control of the Firm’s books and records to produce the consolidated firm, segment and legal entities financial statements, including development, management and oversight of financial accounting & reporting systems as well as database management, including capital and liquidity reporting and external reporting functions.
Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
What You’ll Do In The Role
Collaborate with a varied group of colleagues in Finance and across the Firm
Responsible for both individual and team deliverables and projects, leveraging knowledge of Finance functional area, tools and/or products
Adhere to the Firm’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls
Act as a culture carrier; embody the Firm's values and hold yourself accountable to Firm standards
Responsible for daily bookkeeping /accounting ledger preparation, GL system maintenance, supporting documents preparing and filing; supporting the financial reporting, regulatory reporting, group financial report consolidation and other daily work assigned by the manager
Ensures compliance of the applicable Accounting Standards and regulatory rules and regulations as well as Morgan Stanley’s internal policies and requirements
Support the tax calculation, filing and tax invoice compliance checking, timely escalate tax risk identified
Support the Finance team on project based tasks when needed
What You’ll Bring To The Role
Working knowledge of Finance functional area, industry and competitive environment
Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, and adapt to various audiences
Willingness to seek guidance and provide feedback to further develop self and peers
Relevant experience relating to financial accounting, reporting, tax; prior experience in multi-national financial institution is highly preferred
Bachelor’s degree in relevant field such as business administration, finance, or accounting
Has sufficient knowledge about relevant law and regulatory requirements regarding FX, tax, and futures business in PRC
Good professional ethics, could timely identify and report the issue or potential risks from the compliance and risk management status of the Company’s daily operations
A proactive, self-motivated and dynamic person
Fluent in Chinese Mandarin and English with solid written and verbal communication skills
Familiarity with USGAAP / IFRS accounting treatments and relevant financial report consolidation experiences would be preferred
Certification of Futures Practitioner from China Futures Association is preferred
At least 2 years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role
What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. To learn more about our offices across the globe, please visit https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices.
Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

jobs.descriptionText:
Natixis Corporate & Investment Banking is a leading global financial institution that provides advisory, investment banking, financing, corporate banking and capital markets services to corporations, financial institutions, financial sponsors and sovereign and supranational organizations worldwide.
Our teams of experts in close to 30 countries advise clients on their strategic development, helping them to grow and transform their businesses, and maximize their positive impact. Natixis CIB is committed to aligning its financing portfolio with a carbon neutrality path by 2050 while helping its clients reduce the environmental impact of their business.
As part of Groupe BPCE, the second largest banking group in France through the Banque Populaire and Caisse d’Epargne retail networks, Natixis CIB benefits from the Group’s financial strength and solid financial ratings (Standard & Poor's: A+, Moody's: A2, Fitch: A+, R&I: A+).
Reporting Line
Reports functionally to Head of Financial Control APAC, and locally to Head of Finance China.
Main Responsibilities:
Team Lead – Regional Financial Control
Lead the day-to-day activities of the regional financial control, ensuring accurate, timely, and efficient delivery of activities within the team’s scope.
Manage workforce allocation, provide guidance and training to team members, maintain operational resilience.
Adhere to all accounting controls and governance framework and maintain up-to-date standard operating procedures (SOP) and task lists.
Streamline work processes and initiate automation for process efficiency.
Finance Control Responsibilities - NAPL
Produce and/or manage the full Financial Control activities for Natixis Australia Pty Ltd (“NAPL”), including accounting close and control, group reporting, management reporting, tax, audit, budget/forecast, and minimal regulatory reporting.
LOD1 control/ account substantiation.
Coordinate statutory reporting, tax filing and other ad-hoc requirements.
Operational Transfer Pricing (OTP) - Regional
Act as the SME for APAC recharge process, ensuring OTP calculations, bookings, reconciliations and supporting documentation are completed accurately and on time.
Monitor issues impacting transfer pricing operations and drive timely resolution.
Support reviews, audits and documentation requirements related to OTP processes.
Coordinate with various stakeholders across APAC.
Accounting Controls and regional support
Supervise the daily nostro and suspense reconciliation activities performed by the team
Weekly review of nostro and suspense unmatched and ageing report.
Review the month end journal entries.
Produce or assist in the quarterly group reporting.
Support other regional finance activities /ad-hoc projects.
Required Skills:
Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or related discipline; professional accounting qualification is an advantage.
Minimum 7 years of relevant Accounting/Finance experience in banks
Strong knowledge of IFRS, reconciliations, bank operations and controls.
Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple priorities.
Proficient in MS Office, particularly Excel with automation capability.
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage cross-border relationships effectively.
Support migration and transition of Finance activities into the Shanghai.

About Standard Chartered
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits

A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Senior Team Leader, Business Development Executive, Affluent
Business Development Executive
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Summary
We're looking for a Business Development Executive to drive business growth within our Affluent Banking business. You’ll play a key role in acquiring new clients, strengthening relationships, and delivering personal financial advice.
Your day-to-day will involve planning strategies to meet sales targets, sharing market insights, and supporting promotional activities such as campaigns and seminars. You’ll also ensure smooth after-sales service and identify opportunities to cross-sell relevant products.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, client-focused environment and is passionate about helping people achieve their financial goals.
About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business
Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment including Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.
We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.
We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within the Standard Chartered Group.
Key Responsibilities
Source and engage individual prospects to acquire new business.
Conduct professional, consultative financial analysis sessions with customers.
Identify and articulate customers’ specific financial needs and objectives, offering targeted solutions.
Foster and deepen client relationships by providing regular market updates and financial product trend analysis (both local and international).
Participate in marketing and promotional activities aimed at successful customer acquisition.
Skills And Experience
Strong competencies in client acquisition and sophisticated account management, particularly with High Net Worth (HNW) individuals.
Expertise in region-specific languages and established local networks (highly valued).
Technical knowledge of consumer banking products (Treasury, Equities, Funds, and Insurance).
A university degree is preferred.
Relevant experience in customer service or sales is an advantage; however, applications from fresh graduates who possess the required skills and qualifications will also be considered.
Qualifications
Essential professional qualifications: HKSI Paper 1, 7, 8 and IIQE Paper 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
